newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian Treasury moves to finalise SEAT sale.
newsitem.headline: Italian Treasury moves to finalise SEAT sale.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said on Tuesday that it had asked financial consultants Lehman Brothers to proceed with the final phase of its operation to privatise yellow pages telephone directory group SEAT.
An official statement said the Treasury had asked the consultants to contact companies included on a short list of bidders. It did not identify the companies.
Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said last week that the sale of SEAT would be completed by the spring.
SEAT was floated off from state-controlled telecoms group Stet at the beginning of this year with state industrial holding IRI holding a 61 percent stake.
Italian media reports say four groupings have been shortlisted by the Treasury for consideration in an offer for IRI's stake.

The reports name U.S. telecom group GTE Corp, ITT Corp, a consortium lead by Dutch bank ABN AMRO Holding NV with Italian partners, and an Italian consortium group of De Agostini-L'Espresso-Comit. (( --Rome newsroom +39 6 6782505 ))
